newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Kuala Lumpur blue-chip stock index falls 1.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Kuala Lumpur blue-chip stock index falls 1.5 pct.

text.p: Malaysia's key blue-chip stock index fell 1.50 percent at 0840 GMT on persistent selling by institutions, dealers said.
The Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange's Composite Index dropped 16.33 points to 1,073.12 points.
Buyers also continued to shy away on expectations the market had yet to bottom out, they said.
"The market is sick. Overall sentiment is not good and people are staying away," said an institutional dealer at a local brokerage.
